name: ISENP
note: Current sense positive node: the supply side of the external sense resistor

name: FLIP
note: Type-C flip: low = CC1 detected, high = CC2

name: GPIO
note: General-purpose I/O (only on the AP33772SDKZ-13-FA02 part)

name: INT
note: Interrupt to the MCU: low = normal, high = interrupt

name: VSEL
note: Voltage select: resistor to ground (only on the AP33772SDKZ-13-FA02 part)

name: OTP
note: 100 uA source for an NTC to ground: temperature measurement

name: DN
note: Type-C D-: leave open when moisture detection is not used

name: DP
note: Type-C D+: leave open when moisture detection is not used

name: V5V
note: Alternative 5 V supply path when VCC is off

name: VOUT
note: VOUT monitoring terminal (the sink output voltage)

name: PWR_EN
note: Gate drive of the external NMOS switch that connects the load
